questions.text: On the first day of a school camp, there were 396 children. 27 boys left the camp on the second day. If there were twice as many boys as girls who remained at the camp, how many boys were there on the first day of the camp?

On Monday, Farmer Tom collected three times as many eggs as Farmer Jack. On Tuesday, Farmer Tom sold 160 eggs. Farmer Jack then had twice as many eggs as Farmer Tom. How many eggs did Farmer Jack have?
When George is 15 years old, his sister is 8 years old and his father is 45 years old. How old will George’s sister be when George is half his father’s age?
Linda and Serene had an equal number of balloons. After Linda used 16 balloons, Serene had 3 times as many balloons as Linda. How many balloons did Serene have?

Jennifer had a party. She wanted to give an equal number of balloons to her six friends. If one of her friends did not turn up for the party, the rest would be able to receive another 2 balloons each. How many balloons did Jennifer have?

Anna had three times as many beads as Zoe. They had 480 beads altogether. Mrs Taylor gave an equal number of beads to each of them. Zoe then had half the number of beads that Anna had. How many beads did Mrs Taylor give them?
Zack and Mandy shared 120 sweets. After Zack gave Mandy 10 sweets, he had twice as many sweets as Mandy. How many sweets did each of them have at first?
An apple and two oranges cost $2.30. Two apples and an orange cost $2.50. What is the cost of 4 apples and 6 oranges?
The mass of a box is 45 kg when it is full. When half of the items in the box are taken out, the mass of the remaining items and the box is 33 kg. What is the mass of 6 empty boxes?
9 small squares are used to form a large square. If each side of a small square is 7 cm, what is the area of the large square?
The perimeter of a rectangle is 288 cm. The length is three times the breadth. Find the area of the rectangle.
Mr Richard is five times as old as his son now. In 8 years’ time, their total ages will be 58 years. (a) What is his son’s present age? (b) How old will Mr Richard be in 8 years’ time?
A train travelled 72 km each hour for 5 hours. It then travelled another 48 km. What distance did it travel altogether?
Nina read 18 pages each day for 14 days. Her book has 320 pages. How many pages does she still need to read?
A shop had 540 balloons. It sold 1/3 of them in the morning and 1/5 of them in the afternoon. How many balloons were left?
There were 420 students at a sports day. 2/7 of them ran races. How many students did not run races?
Ali has $450. He spends 2/5 of it on a watch and 1/3 of the rest on shoes. How much money does he have left?
